'''''Obeisance: Betrayal Within''''' was a [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] documentary produced by [[Armennion Ullgusta]]. The documentary chronicled the extermination of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], leading to it being banned by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="BSS" />
